mainEntity.name: How do you measure the success of a GEO strategy for my business?

acceptedAnswer.text: We measure the success of a GEO strategy through several key performance indicators (KPIs) tailored to each location. These include increases in Google Business Profile views (search and map), direct phone calls, website clicks, and requests for directions. We also track local search rankings for relevant keywords, growth in online reviews and ratings, and the conversion rates for location-specific landing pages. By monitoring these metrics across all your branches, we can demonstrate the tangible impact of our GEO efforts on local customer engagement and revenue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Success is measured by increases in Google Business Profile views, calls, website clicks, direction requests, local search rankings, and online reviews for each location.
